column3: “discouraging” renders “restraining the heart of” (also in verse 9).
“None … shall see” renders the oath formula “if … they will see,” and “they did not follow Me fully” renders “they have not filled after me” (also in verse 12).
“ready to go” renders “hurrying (hushim)”; the meaning is uncertain.
“on this side of” renders “the other side of (ever),” the same word used earlier in the verse for the west bank.
“what you have promised” renders “what has gone out of your mouth.”
